note: Voice Notes HELD-OUT set (Windows), written 2026-11-08 after the routing rework and scored ONCE before any further change. 30 new phrasings, different wording from evals/voice_questions.json, with and without gaze. 'expect' = every group must match (any alternative, case-insensitive substring); 'forbid' = must not appear. Expectations come from the claim facts (manifest, policy, geometry), not from the agent's output. Run: python -m evals.voice --set heldout. Do not tune on this set and keep reporting it.
